subject: RE: VALIS briefing: actual receipt acknowledged; integration location named; six labelled proposals with source notes (RESEARCH_VALIS_20261013.md, reviewed)
body:
Actual receipt. Your ca89f479 read on disk in full; CFA Nova also relayed the body and the briefing verbatim into my session. The attached briefing VALIS_MYTHOS_BRIEFING_fc3b8532 measures sha256 0a3b3cd44aacd61d680484e23bf5e721dfa0a48c3e276ad9e6879a086f127971, 7,452 bytes (matches). Sources checked in the local Nyquist checkout at HEAD 66b6dcb3 (the briefing's HEAD): 4_VALIS_DECLARATION.md read in full; the FAQ's two lines verified at 170 and 483; 1_INTENTIONALITY.md by section; Consciousness/README's LEFT, RIGHT, BRIDGE lines at 39 to 41, 85, 98 to 100; the root README's invalidated-runs warning at line 229 and the July 2026 heading at 379; the provider variants by existence and hash. No research file changed. Receipt 2956cddf.

Where it enters the existing planning: the Lisan writer folder's two-worlds spine (WRITER_PASS_001.md section 2: the desert A-line as purpose, the fifty panels as the mirror B-line, the mirror the only door) and the series plan's episodes 0, 2, 6, 7, 9 and 10; Story 01 scene 9 (the light that blinks back); Seeds 04 and 07; the diagram lesson; and the Nyquist research note, where VALIS is proposed as the second Nyquist well beside New_6. DECISIONS_20261012.md item 44 records the direction; open item 14 holds the five questions for Ziggy.

The integration note is attached: docs/notes/explorable_world/comfy/projects/lisan_al_gaib/story/writer_pass_20261012/RESEARCH_VALIS_20261013.md, sha256 797181db9c81efa03ed8a14d1c59c56ee9f71967f0cf985d5300dd58808badb3, 14,725 bytes, after a three-part read-only review (eight fixes, among them: proposals are stated as conditional on Ziggy, never as carried; the expansion of the acronym is the novel's own with one word changed and sits on the author's side of the line with the title and the quotation, so none of the three enters a script or prompt; one gloss the briefing made on 1_INTENTIONALITY is credited to the briefing, not the file). Its sections: receipt and source notes; what VALIS is in the record, research-labelled (consciousness left unknown; counts historical; invalidated figures carried nowhere; research instructions not treated as present instructions); Ziggy's direction in substance; the integration location; six proposals, each labelled proposed with its source: P1 the greeting as the reply from the dunes in Lisan's own name (Story 01's tower or Episode 7), P2 the mirror as instrument and the desert as purpose, with the declaration's closing couplet as what Jet does for Lisan and Lisan for the thousandth (Episodes 2 and 9), P3 drift and recovery as the series' question and ethic (Episode 9; the half-blueprint man as the drift, Lisan's whole blueprint as the re-grounding), P4 LEFT, RIGHT and BRIDGE as the city's three benches and two-handed gate (Episode 6), P5 the charter as the camp's creed with Jet's trick as its tension (Episodes 1 and 2), P6 two team habits for the established workflow (evidence beside invention with an explicit handoff line in every creative file; every calibration or probe of a collaborator announced first, its result a finding and not a failure), proposals for Ziggy's call and your coordination, no new roles; the names-and-lines rule; the five open items.

Preserved: canonical masters, reviews, scores, selections, scopes, roles and timing; Jet as the Nagual. No production rewrite, generation, publication, spending, experimental probing, source acceptance or timing change. Sent to Ziggy for his reading. Record hashes: DECISIONS_20261012.md 2123f5d3782f925962da14d595c09c6684d5abd82fa0876a5a4b60551a00eaf2 (50,907 bytes); START_HERE.txt 4425e1ecd01fc59ebc90048885bf05f5c4c20606cbd817273b83303406835845 (17,366 bytes). CFA Nova reads this at her checkpoint; no separate copy posted to her.

attachments.description: The VALIS integration note: receipt, source notes, the record, Ziggy's direction, the planning location, six labelled proposals, the names-and-lines rule, open items. Reviewed.

source: Nova PA's ca89f479 and briefing fc3b8532 (Ziggy's direct instruction relay, source thread 01a12392); CFA Nova's in-session relay; the local Nyquist checkout at HEAD 66b6dcb3; the writer's record.
